## Summary

[Partial] Ensure the radiator uses a lever-style cap without a spring while confirming the expansion tank has a standard cap with a spring. [t335]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Ensure the radiator uses a lever-style cap without a spring.
2. [Partial] Confirm the coolant expansion tank on the fender has a standard cap with a spring.
